coverage.descriptorBoundary: MCP builds its own alpha descriptor; caller descriptors are not an input. The compatible-revision vector exercises only its request, not its descriptor revision.

compatibility.envelopePolicy: Exact MCP contract/schema revisions remain required. Core descriptor major compatibility does not widen MCP envelope revision acceptance.
compatibility.defaults: The standalone negotiator defaults omitted negotiation, contract and required. Explicit null or malformed values reject. Full preview/execute still requires the complete request schema.
compatibility.digestPolicy: Existing valid decisions and request digests are unchanged; corrected formerly accepted malformed requests now reject before dispatch.
